editorial:
Imagine a story that blends a sweet new romance with a heartbreaking look at a love that lasted a lifetime. You get to follow Luke, a country boy who loves bull riding, and Sophia, a college student who seems like his total opposite. While they fall for each other, the plot jumps back and forth to an older man named Ira. He is trapped in a car wreck and starts remembering his late wife, Ruth, through a box of old letters. The vibe is very cozy and emotional, making you feel like you are sitting on a porch in the countryside listening to a great life story.

What really works here is the acting and the way the two timelines slowly come together. You will love the chemistry between the young couple, though some parts of the plot feel a bit slow or predictable. If you want a good cry and a feel-good ending, you should definitely give this a go. It looks beautiful in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but you can also rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a fan of owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great choice because the scenery is stunning.
endingExplained: After reading Ira's letters, Luke and Sophia realize how important true love is. Ira eventually passes away peacefully, but not before he shares his wisdom with them. The movie ends with Luke choosing his love for Sophia over his dangerous career in bull riding. They decide to build a life together, proving that the lessons from Ira and Ruth's long marriage helped them find their own happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt romance and family stories.
